title: Bringing the magic of AI to Mattel’s iconic brands
summary: OpenAI and Mattel are partnering to integrate AI into iconic brands such as Barbie and Hot Wheels, aiming to enhance creative development, streamline workflows, and create new ways for fans to engage.
body: OpenAI and Mattel are partnering to integrate AI into iconic brands such as Barbie and Hot Wheels, aiming to enhance creative development, streamline workflows, and create new ways for fans to engage.
summaryZh: OpenAI与Mattel达成合作，将AI技术集成至芭比娃娃和风火轮等品牌中。该合作旨在利用AI增强创意开发流程，并为消费者提供全新的品牌互动体验，是AI在消费品行业应用的一个典型案例。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI与Mattel的合作展示了AI在创意产业和品牌互动中的实际应用场景。
